dogecoin.text: The recent uptick in Dogecoin is puzzling to me. While the meme coin's volatility makes it a playground for speculative traders, I remain skeptical of its long-term viability.

Just analyzed today's market trends and, bluntly, Ethereum and Solana are leading the pack while Dogecoin's 32% surge defies fundamental logic. The crowd goes wild for meme coins as the institutional players take positions in real-world use cases.
